title: PDF Too Big to Email? Make a Smaller, Readable Copy
description: Check your email attachment limit, compress a PDF copy and inspect small text before sending. Learn when a sharing link is a better option.
direct: Check the sending account and the recipient's attachment rules first. Compress a separate PDF copy, then verify its file size and readability. If it is still too large, share an access-controlled link or send only the pages the recipient needs.
figureAlt: Three checks for an email PDF: check the receiving limit, inspect text and images in a compressed copy, then test the attachment or sharing link.
figureCaption: File size and legibility both matter. This is an explanatory workflow, not an App screenshot.
cards.limit.heading: Know the limit
cards.limit.body: Personal Gmail allows 25 MB of attachments in total. Work or school limits can be set by an administrator.
cards.copy.heading: Check the copy
cards.copy.body: Small text, form fields, signatures and page count matter more than an advertised compression percentage.
cards.link.heading: Use a link when needed
cards.link.body: A link avoids a large email attachment, but introduces hosting permissions and access requirements.
sections.message-limit.heading: Check the whole message, not just one PDF
sections.message-limit.body: Google lists a 25 MB total attachment limit for personal Gmail and says larger attachments are replaced with a Google Drive link. Work and school account limits may be set by an administrator. Microsoft's Outlook help distinguishes account types and notes that message limits can include the attachment and email itself. The recipient can impose a lower limit too. Read the actual rejection message rather than assuming every provider has the same cap.
sections.browser-copy.heading: Compress a copy in the browser
sections.browser-copy.body: Open our PDF compressor, choose the PDF and start with the Balanced quality option. Compress and download a separate copy. Supported processing runs locally in your browser. Browser PDF exports include a small Just Compress app logo watermark, so check that this is acceptable for your recipient before using it for an application or formal document.
sections.inspect-output.heading: Check the result before attaching it
sections.inspect-output.body: Open the new PDF and compare the first page, the smallest text, diagrams and any signatures with the original. Check page count and file size. Compression can reduce image quality, and an already optimized PDF may barely shrink. Do not promise a fixed percentage or assume that a successful export preserves every document feature. Keep a signed original and follow any requirements for digitally signed files.
sections.sharing-link.heading: If it is still too large
sections.sharing-link.body: Send only the pages the recipient needs if that is allowed, or use a sharing link from an approved service. In Gmail, an oversized attachment may be replaced with a Drive link. In Apple Mail, Mail Drop supports attachments up to 5 GB subject to its service limits. These options upload a copy for sharing. Check recipient permissions and any expiry instead of describing them as no-upload delivery.
sections.iphone.heading: On iPhone
sections.iphone.body: Our App, PDF Compressor: Sign & Merge, offers PDF compression and related document tools. Check the verified App Store listing below for current purchase options. Export a copy, inspect the actual PDF, then attach it using your mail app. The app name does not establish that every export will satisfy a particular portal or mail server.
faqs.target-size.heading: What size should I target for email?
faqs.target-size.body: Use the actual sending and receiving limits, counting all attachments. Leave room under the applicable limit. There is no universal safe size for every account.
faqs.compression-result.heading: Will PDF compression always make the file much smaller?
faqs.compression-result.body: No. Image-heavy documents may shrink more than text-heavy or already optimized files. Inspect the actual result and readability.
faqs.watermark.heading: Does the free browser PDF tool add a watermark?
faqs.watermark.body: Yes. Browser PDF exports include a small Just Compress app logo watermark. Check the output and the recipient's requirements before sending.
